_README: Hand-maintained. Screened against one specific profile: Indian citizen, 34 on 1 July 2027, IELTS 7.0 overall / 6.5 writing, ~10 years research experience, M.Sc. + B.Tech. The 'blocks' field is the point — it names what would disqualify you before you spend time. Verify everything at source; scheme terms change annually.

_verified_values.checked: Confirmed against the issuing organisation's own page on the date shown
_verified_values.lead: Not checked — treat as a starting point only

_fit_values.possible: Worth checking, with a real caveat
_fit_values.blocked: A named criterion disqualifies you as things stand

funding.name: ERC-funded doctoral and postdoctoral posts
funding.what: Grant holders hire their own researchers at their own discretion. This is the route the roster is built around — no cohort call, no nationality quota, no ranking requirement.
funding.blocks: None structural. Posts are advertised on each university's own board, often briefly, and sometimes filled before advertisement.
funding.why: The only route on this list where a decade of experience is an asset rather than an eligibility problem.

funding.name: MSCA COFUND doctoral programmes
funding.what: Cohort-based salaried doctoral programmes across Europe. RESDOC at Helsinki is one instance; dozens run annually on staggered deadlines.
funding.blocks: Most impose an early-stage researcher rule — under 4 years of research experience, counted from the qualifying degree. Your CV may exceed it. Also an MSCA mobility rule: not more than 12 months in the host country in the preceding 36.
funding.why: Get the experience count ruled on in writing by the programme office before applying. Supervisors routinely misread this.

funding.name: RESDOC — University of Helsinki
funding.what: 30 salaried doctoral positions across four themes including biodiversity and resilience. Starts Jan–Mar 2027.
funding.blocks: Early-stage researcher criterion — under 4 years research experience. This is the open question on your application.
funding.why: Di Minin is in the supervisor pool. Even if the eligibility ruling goes against you, his BIOBANG grant runs to 2030 and hires independently.

funding.name: MSCA Doctoral Networks
funding.what: Consortium-based doctoral training. Positions advertised individually on EURAXESS rather than as one cohort call.
funding.blocks: Same early-stage researcher and mobility rules as COFUND.
funding.why: Search EURAXESS for 'Doctoral Network' plus your topic terms rather than waiting for a central call.

funding.name: Nordic and Dutch employed doctorates
funding.what: In Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and the Netherlands a doctorate is a job. Selection reads like hiring, not admissions.
funding.blocks: None on nationality or age. English requirements usually 6.5–7.0, which your bands clear.
funding.why: Your publication record and applied experience count for more here than in any admissions-based system.

funding.name: Swami Vivekananda Scholarship for Academic Excellence
funding.value: Tuition up to ~INR 50 lakh; living allowance varies by income category
funding.what: Rajasthan domicile scheme for study abroad. Conditional offer accepted at application; unconditional letter due within two months of provisional selection.
funding.blocks: Age under 35 on 1 July — your last clean cycle is 2027–28. THE top-50 institutions only, not QS. Reported 75% / 7.5 CGPA qualifying threshold conflicts with older 60% sources. E1 → E2 → E3 evaluation order puts you second in line as E2.
funding.why: Verify the marks threshold against your own transcripts before anything else. It can disqualify you outright and is the cheapest thing to check.

funding.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
funding.what: Master's and PhD scholarships for citizens of Commonwealth countries. India is eligible. Nominated through approved bodies.
funding.blocks: No upper age limit in most streams. Requires a specific nominating route — check which applies to you before drafting anything.
funding.why: One of very few full-cost routes into the UK that sidesteps the UKRI 30% international cap entirely.

funding.name: Chevening
funding.what: One-year UK master's for emerging leaders. Requires around two years' work experience — you have far more.
funding.blocks: Master's only, not doctoral. Carries a return-home requirement. One year is short for the research training you want.
funding.why: A poor fit for a doctoral trajectory, but the leadership framing suits your CV if you decide a UK master's is the route.

funding.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
funding.what: Master's scholarships explicitly aimed at professionals with work experience and demonstrated leadership.
funding.blocks: Master's level only. Cycle dates not confirmed here.
funding.why: The 'global professional' framing fits an applicant with a decade of applied work better than most academic schemes.

funding.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
funding.what: Multi-country master's programmes with integrated full scholarships. No age bar in most.
funding.blocks: Master's level, so it does not advance a doctoral timeline directly.
funding.why: Worth scanning the catalogue for anything on conservation data or environmental humanities.

funding.name: DAAD scholarship database
funding.what: Searchable database of German funding for international researchers at every career stage.
funding.blocks: Some doctoral schemes impose age or years-since-degree limits. Filter carefully.
funding.why: Germany also runs salaried TV-L E13 doctoral posts, which do not need a scholarship at all.

funding.name: JN Tata Endowment
funding.what: Long-established Indian endowment for graduate study abroad in any field.
funding.blocks: It is a loan, repayable. Annual cycle, typically opening early in the calendar year.
funding.why: Useful as a gap-filler alongside a partial award rather than as a primary route.

funding.name: KC Mahindra Scholarships
funding.what: For Indian graduates pursuing postgraduate study abroad.
funding.blocks: Interest-free but repayable. Competitive and modest in value relative to European tuition.
funding.why: Same gap-filler logic as the Tata endowment.

funding.name: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarship
funding.what: Prestigious Indian scholarship for study abroad.
funding.blocks: Age limit is typically 30 at application. At 33 you are almost certainly outside it.
funding.why: Listed so you do not spend an evening discovering this yourself. Confirm and then close it out.

funding.name: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships
funding.what: India-specific US programmes including doctoral research fellowships and master's awards.
funding.blocks: US visa environment adds risk. Doctoral research fellowships require existing Indian PhD enrolment in some streams — check which category applies.
funding.why: The doctoral research fellowship is worth understanding even if you do not use it, because it structures a lot of India-US academic mobility.

funding.name: Rotary Peace Fellowships
funding.what: Fully funded programmes at partner universities, aimed at mid-career professionals in peace and development.
funding.blocks: Framing is peace and conflict rather than conservation. You would need to make the environmental-conflict link explicitly.
funding.why: Mid-career framing is rare and suits you; the thematic stretch is the cost.

funding.name: Aga Khan Foundation ISP
funding.what: Postgraduate scholarships for students from selected countries including India.
funding.blocks: Half is a loan. Applications open once a year, typically January to March.
funding.why: Applies to doctoral study, which several Indian schemes on this list do not.

funding.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
funding.what: Research and PhD scholarships. Requires a supervisor's acceptance letter before applying.
funding.blocks: Age limits apply in some categories, often born after a stated year. Check the India-specific call.
funding.why: The supervisor-first requirement suits the outreach strategy you are already running.

funding.name: Australia Awards / RTP stipends
funding.what: Australian universities fund international doctoral students through RTP stipends awarded internally.
funding.blocks: Competitive and university-administered rather than centrally applied for. UQ ranks well in QS but far lower in THE, so it is likely outside SVS eligibility.
funding.why: Relevant if you pursue Richard Fuller at UQ — the funding would come through the university, not the scholarship.
